headlines.title: NASA Invites Media to Djibouti Artemis Accords Signing Ceremony
headlines.summary: The Republic of Djibouti will sign the Artemis Accords during a ceremony at 11 a.m. EDT, Monday, Sept. 14, at NASA Headquarters in Washington, becoming the 72nd country signatory. NASA Deputy Administrator Matt Anderson
